channel.description: Essays by Rene Zou on strategy, founders, and the gap between vision and execution.

item.title: If You're a Founder, Read This
item.dc:creator: Rene Zou
item.description: Everyone wants to be a founder. But what actually makes you one? Being a founder isn't registering a company, building a product in stealth, or becoming your own boss. I think the answer lies somewhere between ownership, agency and legacy: what you choose to build, why it has to be yours, and what you hope remains when you're gone.

item.title: Velocity > Speed
item.dc:creator: Rene Zou
item.description: “Move fast and break things” is passé. In a world where everyone can build faster, speed is no longer the advantage it once was. The founders who win won't just move fast – they'll move with velocity: speed with direction.
